simple.meaning: גַּבְלֻת (gabluth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a twisted chain or lace.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גַּבְלֻת (H1383) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 28:22, with occurrences in Exodus.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גַּבְלֻת (H1383) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גַּבְלֻת (H1383) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גַּבְלֻת (gabluth) / H1383 is traced through Exodus 28:22, Exodus 39:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
